adversarial_review.reason:
Want: a worthwhile contract-restoring fix for users of advertised prompt aliases, but the current contribution is incomplete. Pinned docs/servers/prompts.mdx promises signature validation and typed string conversion; the source constructs advertised arguments from the Pydantic validation schema. This establishes the framework-level expectation that its advertised input is usable, without claiming that MCP mandates Pydantic aliases. The failure originates in renderer filtering, not installation: retained verification records missing alias keys and silently ignored explicit values, and independent execution reproduced the six failing alias tests on the pinned base with the ordinary-name control passing.

Commands actually executed: bounded git init/fetch/checkout of base 0a125c1c0b5a619275de913bc5b355cd258af781, fetch of contributor head 54c49cc32d487a6705665062fcb9c11bb7bf472f, and `uv sync --quiet`. Copied the exact head's test_prompt.py onto the unchanged base and ran `uv run pytest tests/prompts/test_prompt.py -k 'TestPromptArgumentAliases' -n 0 --tb=no -q`: 6 failed, 1 passed. Restored that temporary test change, checked out the exact head, and ran `uv run pytest tests/prompts/test_prompt.py -n 0 --tb=short -q`: 71 passed, 3 warnings. An initial checkout was rejected because of the temporary test copy; restoring it resolved that safely. No source changes or commits were made.

Independent `uv run python /tmp/probe_alias.py` at the exact head exposed a reachable partial fix: `name: str = Field(alias='Name', validation_alias='Input')` advertises Input and the same call adapter accepts Input='Ada', but render drops Input and raises a missing-argument PromptError. With default='default', the same explicit input silently returns 'got default' instead of 'got Ada'. The helper chooses alias before validation_alias, contrary to the validation schema. The probe also exercised a real in-memory Client.get_prompt control using an Annotated integer alias; it returned 'got 5'. This is a localized precedence repair, not an unresolved product choice or grounds for replacing the reporter's contribution.

Supplied bot feedback was read: the no-findings review covers old commit 28e9807, not the verified head. The issue-link failure is administrative; supplied CI still has nine jobs in progress. Full/static validation, independent-agent adversarial review, current-target composition and live platform preflights were not performed. Focused passing tests do not establish merge readiness.

Preserve the injected-parameter exclusion and ordinary-name controls. Re-run focused base/head tests and applicable static checks on the revised head; then refresh CI and revision-specific review. Keep assignment separate pending the required public-history and live eligibility checks; do not create a competing fix or treat the administrative gate as a code defect.
